@labels.element: {kind} is attached or object and chooses the words: keep it in English; {id} is the number of the object, shown unchanged. The text stands inside sentences, so write it as it reads there
labels.change_type.tooltip: Choose another object file for it in the library; its place and labels stay
labels.heading: Labels
labels.apply.tooltip: Writes all lines; they fill the object's string variables in order, such as a sign's text or the line number on a plate
labels.note.own: Added by {variant}: its own record changes.
@labels.note.own: {variant} is the name of the chrono variant, shown unchanged
labels.note.other: A new type or new labels are written into {variant} ([selobject] with [typ] or [relabel]); the {origin, select, variant {variant that adds it} other {base map}} keeps its own.
@labels.note.other: {origin} is variant or base and chooses the words: keep it in English
labels.pick.title: New object file
labels.pick.cancel.tooltip: Leave the type as it is (Esc)
labels.pick.hint: Choose the object that {element} becomes. It keeps its place, orientation and labels.
labels.pick.panel: Click the new object for {element}; Esc leaves it as it is.
labels.status.pick: Click the new object for {element} in the library.
labels.status.stays: The type stays as it is.
labels.status.type_failed: The type could not be changed ({element}): {reason}
@labels.status.type_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
labels.status.labels_failed: The labels could not be changed ({element}): {reason}
@labels.status.labels_failed: {reason} is a message from the system, in English
@labels.done.type: {element} starts the sentence: it is written with a capital first letter
labels.done: {done}{inVariant, select, yes { in {variant}} other {}}. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
